claims: The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, CA.
The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival takes place on April 10–12 and April 17–19, 2026.
Headliners at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival are Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma.
The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival features 8+ stages.
The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival features sets from Bini, FKA Twigs, and The Strokes.
Key performers at Weekend 1 of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival are The Strokes, FKA Twigs, Bini, and Iggy Pop.
YouTube is the exclusive livestream partner for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
YouTube broadcasts sets like Justin Bieber’s at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Heineken House featured performances by Wale, Sean Paul, and Motion City Soundtrack.
Tickets for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival went on sale in September 2025.
Tickets for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival sold out within a week.
General Admission tickets for Week 1 of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival were $649.
General Admission tickets for Week 2 of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival were $549.
VIP tickets for Week 1 of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival were $1,299.
VIP tickets for Week 2 of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival were $1,199.
Further availability for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is managed via the official Coachella waitlist system.
Exclusive events included the Desert Nights after-party at Zenyara Estate.
Exclusive events included Caravana's anniversary gathering.
Attendees included Paris Hilton, Lizzo, and Katy Perry.
